create_async_client_device: create an AsyncClientDevice to represent a single async FL device with training schedule and client
create_async_client_factory: use AsyncClientFactory.create to build an async client device from an event generator and user selector
train_local_model: call train_local_model on an AsyncClientDevice to perform local training and return delta and weight
start_training_on_device: call training_started on an AsyncClientDevice to save the global model and begin training
check_device_waiting_state: call is_waiting_to_start on an AsyncClientDevice to check if it is waiting to begin training
